key_results.value: Llama 2 70B reaches MMLU 68.9, BBH 51.2, AGI Eval 54.2, beating all open-source baselines (MPT-30B, Falcon-40B, Llama 1 65B)
Llama 2 70B improves over Llama 1 65B by ~5 points on MMLU and ~8 points on BBH

ev.quote: Llama 2 70B improves the results on MMLU and BBH by \approx5 and \approx8 points, respectively, compared to Llama 1 65B

key_results.value: Llama 2 70B closes ground on GPT-3.5: MMLU 68.9 vs 70.0 and GSM8K 56.8 vs 57.1 (still a gap on coding)

ev.quote: Llama 2 70B is close to GPT-3.5 (OpenAI, 2023) on MMLU and GSM8K, but there is a significant gap on coding benchmarks

key_results.value: Pretraining cost: 3.3M GPU-hours on A100-80GB and 539 tCO2eq emitted (100% offset by Meta)

ev.quote: A cumulative of 3.3M GPU hours of computation was performed on hardware of type A100-80GB (TDP of 400W or 350W). We estimate the total emissions for training to be 539 tCO2eq
we develop and release Llama 2, a collection of pretrained and fine-tuned large language models (LLMs)
We use the standard transformer architecture [(Vaswani et al., 2017)](#page-43-2), apply pre-normalization using RMSNorm
We pretrained our models on Meta's Research Super Cluster (RSC) (Lee and Sengupta, 2022) as well as internal production clusters. Both clusters use NVIDIA A100s

strengths.value: Open release of competitive 7B/13B/70B base + chat models with permissive license enables reproducible research and commercial use.

ev.quote: Our models outperform open-source chat models on most benchmarks we tested, and based on our human evaluations for helpfulness and safety, may be a suitable substitute for closed-source models

strengths.value: Architectural upgrades over Llama 1: 4k context, 40% more pretraining tokens, and grouped-query attention for inference scaling.

ev.quote: we performed more robust data cleaning, updated our data mixes, trained on 40% more total tokens, doubled the context length, and used grouped-query attention (GQA)

strengths.value: Detailed safety methodology: red-teaming, safety-tuning, iterative RLHF, and Ghost Attention for multi-turn dialogue control.

ev.quote: We provide a detailed description of our approach to fine-tuning and safety improvements of Llama 2-Chat

strengths.value: Closes much of the gap to GPT-3.5 on MMLU and GSM8K and is on par with PaLM-540B on most benchmarks.

ev.quote: Llama 2 70B results are on par or better than PaLM (540B) (Chowdhery et al., 2022) on almost all benchmarks

weaknesses.value: Knowledge frozen post-pretraining; the model can produce non-factual content and hallucinations.

ev.quote: Llama 2-Chat is subject to the same well-recognized limitations of other LLMs, including a cessation of knowledge updates post-pretraining, potential for non-factual generation

weaknesses.value: Predominantly English; performance in other languages is fragile and should be used with caution.

ev.quote: the model's performance in languages other than English remains fragile and should be used with caution

weaknesses.value: Safety tuning sometimes overshoots, causing the model to refuse benign requests or add excessive safety caveats.

ev.quote: in some instances, our safety tuning goes too far. Users of Llama 2-Chat may observe an overly cautious approach, with the model erring on the side of declining certain requests

weaknesses.value: Can still emit harmful, offensive, or biased content because pretraining data is drawn from public web sources.

ev.quote: Llama 2 may generate harmful, offensive, or biased content due to its training on publicly available online datasets

limitations.value: Paper does not study post-training quantization or low-bit deployment of Llama 2 weights.

ev.quote: We adopt most of the pretraining setting and model architecture from Llama 1

limitations.value: Largest released model is 70B; the trained 34B variant is held back, limiting the open scaling story.

ev.quote: We have also trained 34B variants, which we report on in this paper but are not releasing

limitations.value: All testing was performed in English and could not cover all deployment scenarios.

ev.quote: Testing conducted to date has been in English and has not - and could not - cover all scenarios

limitations.value: Reports no per-token inference latency or edge-device deployment numbers; hardware focus is data-center A100.

future_work_stated.value: Continue to fine-tune and release updated versions to address bias and harmful content, especially for non-English languages.

ev.quote: We will continue to fine-tune and release updated versions in the future as we progress on addressing these issues

future_work_stated.value: Encourage more community research and red-teaming on tool-use safety with Llama 2-Chat.

ev.quote: LLM tool use, while exciting, can also cause some safety concerns. We encourage more community research and red teaming in this area

future_work_stated.value: Explore alternative human-preference collection schemes beyond binary comparison for reward modeling.

ev.quote: Still, other strategies are worth considering, which we leave for future work

future_work_stated.value: Plan further improvements to Llama 2-Chat as part of ongoing transparency and safety commitments.

ev.quote: we plan to make further improvements to Llama 2-Chat in future work
We estimate the total emissions for training to be 539 tCO2eq, of which 100% were directly offset by Meta's sustainability program
